entities.summary: WASP-33b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star HD 15082. It was the first transiting planet discovered to orbit a Delta Scuti variable star. With a semimajor axis of 0.026 AU and a mass likely greater than Jupiter's, it belongs to the hot Jupiter class of planets.
